name: Rolen ChromeSync Interface Glove
description:
Wrist-length haptic interface gloves in brushed slate polymer with copper-trace circuit lines running from fingertip to wrist port connector — visible through a semi-transparent dorsal panel. Designed for aug-to-digital handshake: the glove bridges the gap between a chrome forearm and a biological palm, providing haptic feedback to the wearer's residual nerve endings or BCI. Available in full-hand and half-finger cuts.

The fingertips carry conductive haptic pads layered over micro-actuator arrays. The wrist connector is standardized to Rolen's ChromeSeam port spec, compatible with most major aug brands. Clean industrial aesthetic, no visible branding except a small embossed port-mark at the cuff.
functionality: Haptic feedback translation from chrome forearm to biological nerve endings or BCI. Full-hand and half-finger cuts available. Standardized ChromeSeam wrist port connects to Rolen and most third-party aug systems. Tactile resolution sufficient for surgical-grade manipulation tasks. Gene-compatible half-finger cut accommodates minor digit geneware modifications.
what_it_says: Your augmentation is not a limitation — it is an interface, and you have learned to use it precisely.
worn_by: chrome-arm aug users seeking haptic restoration
price_range: Φ380–Φ950 per pair depending on cut and haptic resolution tier
story_hooks: A pair is found configured with a custom haptic profile that maps to a classified Arcturus military aug system — the profile shouldn't exist on a civilian glove.
A Tier 3 technician has been wearing the same pair for four years, refusing replacements — the haptic calibration has drifted to match their specific nerve damage in a way no new pair can replicate.
Someone has modified a pair to transmit haptic data outbound — every surface the wearer touches is being logged and transmitted to an unknown receiver.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist haptic interface glove that signals high-tier augmentation integration. The brushed slate polymer gives it a matte, professional appearance—neither chrome-bright nor street-worn. Sits at the intersection of medical device and luxury tech wear. Worn across all Tier 1-2 corpo environments and by augmented professionals.
physical_description.fit: Precision-tailored to the hand and wrist with elastic compression zones at the palm and wrist cuff. Form-fitting but not restrictive—designed to work over residual biological limbs or directly interface with chrome forearms. The wrist port connector sits snug against the augmentation mounting point.
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed slate polymer composite with embedded copper-trace conductive circuits. Semi-transparent dorsal panel reveals the circuit architecture beneath. Fingertip pads are layered conductive haptic material over micro-actuator arrays. Wrist cuff reinforced with ballistic weave for durability.
physical_description.texture: Matte, slightly textured brushed finish on the exterior polymer. The dorsal panel has a subtle translucent quality—you can see the copper traces catching light. Fingertip pads have a softer, more tactile texture than the palm. The wrist cuff feels slightly rigid from reinforcement.
physical_description.color_scheme: Brushed slate gray as the primary color. Copper-trace circuits visible through the dorsal panel create warm metallic accents. The port connector at the cuff is gunmetal with a small embossed Rolen mark in faint silver.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit elastic cuff with a standardized Rolen ChromeSeam port connector at the wrist—magnetic-locking mechanical interface. No visible zippers or buckles. The glove sits open at the wrist end, designed to slide over or dock with augmentation hardware.
distinctive_features: Semi-transparent dorsal panel revealing copper-trace circuit lines
Conductive haptic pads on all fingertips with embedded micro-actuator arrays
Standardized Rolen ChromeSeam port connector at wrist cuff
Small embossed port-mark (Rolen branding) at cuff—minimal corporate marking
Available in full-hand and half-finger configurations
Reinforced ballistic weave at wrist compression zone
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury/professional. The precision engineering, haptic integration, and corpo-standard port spec mark this as high-end augmentation accessory. Not salvage, not street-tier.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented corpo workers, medical technicians, neural interface specialists, and chrome-augmented professionals navigating the GLMZ's digital economy. Signals seamless integration between flesh and machine—the wearer is post-human by choice and resource. A status object in circles where augmentation is normalized and expected.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to well-maintained. Rolen products are durable; these rarely show wear unless heavily used in field conditions. Fingertip pads may show minor contact wear over time. Kept clean by corpo users—visible dirt or damage would signal inferior augmentation care.
